description: Highest-volume OPEN Polymarket markets right now — sorted by trading volume in the chosen window (24hr / 1wk / 1mo / 1yr / all). The "where is real money going this week" lens. Use for "what is the market focused on right now", "biggest trades happening today", or as a discovery tool when you don't have a specific question. Each result has live yes/no prices in [0,1] = implied probability.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the volume-ranked list (default 0). Use offset=100 (with limit=100) to fetch ranks 101–200, offset=200 for 201–300, etc. — walk the pages to build a true top-N-by-volume set.

name: polymarket_top_markets
